subject: FinLynx procurement kickoff — DPA, SOC 2 link, and PO instructions
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@finlynx.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@finlynx.com
Date: 2026-10-03T16:02:00Z
Subject: Vendor packet needed to complete onboarding

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking this — FinLynx is ready to move Redwood to our vendor registry but our procurement team requires a few items before we can issue the PO: 

- Executed DPA (we can accept DocuSign)
- Most recent SOC 2 Type II report or a hosted link to download it
- Full subprocessor list (CSV preferred)
- Vendor billing remittance instructions and whether Redwood can accept a credit card or requires ACH/PO first

I attached our vendor intake form (minimal fields) and included our procurement inbox above. Our target is to have Redwood accepted by 10/15 so we can align with our quarterly vendor cutover.

Can you confirm an estimated turnaround time and whether you have a standard master DPA we can review?

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Vendor Programs — FinLynx
elena@finlynx.com

Attachment: finlynx_vendor_intake_template.xlsx (stub)

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@finlynx.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-03T18:25:00Z
Subject: Re: Vendor packet needed to complete onboarding

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear checklist and the intake form. Looping in Rishi (legal) and Vanessa (finance) to help with the PO/billing side.

Quick answers and next steps: 
- DPA: attaching our standard DPA (Redwood_DPA_v3.docx). We can e-sign via DocuSign; please let me know the best email to send the envelope to.
- SOC 2: hosted link below (PDF available). Last audit period ended 2026-06; report covers our serving runtime and control environment.
- Subprocessors: attaching the CSV (subprocessors_2026.csv). We keep a rolling list and provide 30-day notice for changes.
- Billing/PO: we accept ACH and corporate card for initial smaller invoices; for contractual commitments we prefer PO + ACH/Net30. Vanessa will confirm vendor code and remittance header.

Estimated turnaround: we can have a DocuSign envelope and the completed onboarding package back to you within 24 business hours once you confirm the e-sign contact and whether you need any redlines on the DPA. If you require SOC 2 bridge letters or a scoped auditor confirmation, that will add a few days.

Next items from FinLynx: please send the procurement contact and remit details you will use on the PO (billing address, tax id if applicable) and confirm whether FinLynx requires EU data residency commitments or any clause variations.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Procurement Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v3.docx (stub), subprocessors_2026.csv (stub)
Links: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1SOC2-report-2026

From: Elena Morales <elena@finlynx.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@finlynx.com
Date: 2026-10-04T09:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Vendor packet needed to complete onboarding

Irene — great, thanks. A few clarifications from procurement: 

- Please send the DocuSign envelope to procure@finlynx.com and copy me. We try to keep legal redlines to a minimum; if there are standard exceptions for data residency in EU, call them out.
- PO contact: Michael O'Connor (m.oconnor@finlynx.com) — he will create the PO once the vendor is approved. Billing address is below; tax ID will be provided on the PO.
- For speed, can Redwood issue a single invoice up to $5,000 on corporate card while PO is processed? If so, we can start with a pilot invoice and then route the PO for the longer-term commitment.

Billing remittance: FinLynx AP
FinLynx, Inc.
420 Harbor Drive
Boston, MA 02110

If you can confirm the DocuSign link and send over the signed DPA, we'll queue the PO for approval.

Thanks,
Elena

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, procurement@finlynx.com
Date: 2026-10-05T09:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Vendor packet needed to complete onboarding — Docusign & PO options

Elena / Michael — following up with everything you requested. 

- DocuSign: envelope created and sent to procure@finlynx.com. Link: https://www.docusign.com/Redwood-DPA-ESIGN-FLX-2026 (live for 14 days).
- SOC 2: hosted PDF link above (same as attachment). Audit period 2025-07 through 2026-06; control opinion is unqualified.
- Subprocessors: attached CSV includes name, role, region, and purpose. If you need a signed subprocessor attestation, we can provide that under NDA.
- Billing: Vanessa confirms we can accept a corporate card invoice up to $5,000 while PO is routing. For PO-based billing we'll need the PO number and remit address exactly as it appears on your PO. 

Timeline: once DPA is signed and we receive the PO or card payment, we will issue a vendor code and provide access keys for the pilot accounts within 48 hours.

If FinLynx requires any specialty clauses (data residency, additional audit rights), Rishi can review and propose narrow language rather than a full redline to speed approval.

Thanks — will standby for the signed DPA or confirmation of card payment to start the pilot.

Irene Choi
Head of Procurement Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx (completed by Redwood), SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf (stub)
